title: A countable family of C¹ test functions separating integrable functions on an interval
statement: For all real numbers c, d there is a sequence (F_n)_{n∈ℕ} of C¹ functions ℝ → ℝ with tsupport F_n ⊆ (c, d) for every n, with the following property: every function w : ℝ → ℝ that is integrable on (c, d) and satisfies ∫_ℝ F_n(α)·w(α) dα = 0 for all n vanishes almost everywhere on (c, d).
lean_statement: ∀ c d : ℝ, ∃ F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F n)) ∧ (∀ n, tsupport (F n) ⊆ Ioo c d) ∧ ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn w (Ioo c d) → (∀ n, ∫ α, F n α * w α = 0) → ∀ᵐ α, α ∈ Ioo c d → w α = 0
